Run APSIM forward over a simulation file

Source: R/predict.R
apsim_predict.Rd

Runs the simulator on a copy of sim (the source file and its DataStore are never touched), reads the requested report from the resulting DataStore, and returns it as a predictions apsim_manifest(). A single Models invocation builds the file once and runs every simulation it contains (including any factorial fan-out) across cores. Returns an apsim_abstention() when the simulator is unavailable or the run fails.

Usage

apsim_predict(sim, report = NULL, simulations = NULL, cpu = NULL)

Arguments

sim

An apsim_sim object or a path to an .apsimx file.

report

Character report-table name, or NULL for the first report.

simulations

Optional regular expression selecting simulations to run (--simulation-names).

cpu

Optional integer thread cap; NULL uses all cores.

Value

An apsim_manifest with inferential_target = "predictions" carrying the simulated report in outputs, or an apsim_abstention.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # apsimR::apsim_available()
# Running APSIM over a real simulation file takes several seconds, so the
# call is wrapped in \donttest{}; it runs under R CMD check --run-donttest.
f <- apsim_example("Wheat")
# \donttest{
if (!is.na(f)) {
  m <- apsim_predict(f)
  m@inferential_target
}
# }
}
